rules.quoted_span: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental units in Santa Ana
rules.exemptions: buildings constructed after February 1, 1995 (per D085); mobile home spaces offered after January 1, 1990 (per D085)
rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance (annual cap)
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases may not exceed the lower of 3% or 80% of the CPI change; the maximum for Sept 1, 2026 to Aug 31, 2027 is 2.87%.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance (Rent Stabilization Program)

rules.quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental units in Santa Ana
rules.key_value: just cause required; relocation assistance for no-fault terminations
rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: A landlord needs a valid reason (such as non-payment, lease violation or owner move-in) to evict; for certain no-fault reasons the landlord may owe relocation assistance.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance (Rent Stabilization Program)
